items.intent: Create one clearly marked beta drink request, prove pending visibility and rejection flow, inspect resulting history, and attempt supported cleanup of the pending record.
items.risk: Creates drink/request history and may queue verification notifications. Rejection/history can be permanent; do not run casually.

items.intent: Run one separately chosen reversible/admin-audited mutation only after its exact target and rollback are reviewed.
items.risk: Writes admin/audit/business records. No generic multi-admin mutation harness is considered armed.

items.intent: Trigger one known simple badge criterion through a controlled outcome and verify profile/leaderboard rendering.
items.risk: May create permanent badge and supporting game/drink history. No generic badge mutation should run without a target-specific plan.

items.intent: Run exactly one explicitly selected remaining game write: GEJAST_BETA_WRITE_TARGET=beerpong, boerenbridge, or rad. Klaverjas is already proven and is excluded.
items.risk: Creates a clearly marked game/spin/history record and may affect stats/ratings/odds. The harness does not automatically erase audited history.

items.intent: Apply one explicitly reversible profile edit only after the original value and restoration path are captured, verify rendering, then restore it.
items.risk: Temporarily changes a real player profile/avatar/display value. No profile mutation harness is considered armed until restore is guaranteed.
